text: Let's start with a PowerPoint theme you already trust. Bento-deck-studio reads the colors, type, slide size, layouts, and candidate images—without changing your source file. Review those theme tokens first; then use them as a visual starting point for the story.

Now, bring a topic, an outline, or a Markdown script. The authoring flow turns it into native Bento slides—not flattened images. Each slide lands one clear message, with an easy-to-follow hierarchy and a layout you can revisit as the story evolves.

Before the deck is written, the builder verifies Bento's signed release manifest and checks the shell hash. That way, it starts from a trusted shell. Add your own image as a favicon, or let the site make a monogram from your theme colors.

Need a quick share? The default is a simple launch page, with the presentation one click away. Want a fuller story? Choose the companion site instead. Slides sits first in the menu and opens a read-only deck in a new tab, keeping the slide content intact and the site easy to host.

Before you share, let's check every slide in the browser, then check the links and favicon. The public deck drops speaker notes and collaboration credentials. And that's it—your theme and your story, ready to present, with the editability intact.
